package main
import (
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 tailwind "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rules/tailwind/collapse"
)
func main() {
 data,err:=os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]);if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 var inputs []string;if err=json.Unmarshal(data,&inputs);err!=nil {panic(err)}
 for _,input:=range inputs {fmt.Println(tailwind.AdamicCSSIdentifierUnescape(input))}
}
